SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) rl, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, SUM(quantity) q, SUM(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, MIN(sale_date) d0, MAX(sale_date) d1
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20'

SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(*) n, SUM(quantity) q FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20' AND (s.store_id>=900 OR s.store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current)) GROUP BY 1

WITH stock AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.closing_units) AS closing_units
    FROM fact_stock_week f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE f.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
),
sold AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_4w
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20' AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT st.category, st.closing_units, so.units_4w, ROUND(so.units_4w / 4.0, 1) AS avg_weekly_units,
       ROUND(st.closing_units / (so.units_4w / 4.0), 2) AS weeks_of_cover
FROM stock st JOIN sold so ON so.category = st.category
ORDER BY st.category
